title: Can You Afford To Buy A Home?
subtitle: A practical starting point before you browse listings.
paragraphs: Most buyers start with a monthly payment target, not a list price.
Your down payment, debts, and location all change what is realistic.
A few quick estimates can save months of guessing.

title: Mortgage Rates And Monthly Payments
subtitle: Why small rate changes can shift your buying power.
paragraphs: Monthly payment matters more than the sticker price for most households.
Insurance, taxes, and HOA fees belong in the same calculation.
Compare scenarios before you fall in love with a property.

title: From Search To Closing
subtitle: What the full home-buying journey usually looks like.
paragraphs: Pre-approval, search, offer, inspection, and closing each have their own timeline.
Knowing the sequence reduces surprises late in the process.
The right next step depends on where you are today.
